meta.warning: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. Fictitious labelers, invented prices, illustrative payer formulas. Do not use for real purchasing.

payers.name: State Medicaid (sample NADAC + fee model)
payers.notes: Many state Medicaid programs pay NADAC (or WAC if no NADAC) plus a professional dispensing fee. Fee here is illustrative; look up your state's actual fee.

payers.name: Commercial PBM A (sample generic MAC)
payers.notes: Pays the plan's Maximum Allowable Cost per unit regardless of NDC, so NDC choice only changes your acquisition cost.

payers.name: Commercial PBM B (sample lesser of AWP-84% or MAC)
payers.notes: Reimbursement depends on the specific NDC's AWP until the MAC cap binds, so high-AWP NDCs can reimburse more.

payers.name: Medicare Part D plan (sample AWP-80% + fee)
payers.notes: Pure AWP-discount pricing; NDC-specific AWP drives reimbursement.
